## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: When two open changes modify the same Requirement heading of a capability,...

The system SHALL ensure that when two open changes modify the same Requirement heading of a capability, the second /plan-feature run reports the collision, the other change, and its owner before tasks are generated.

#### Scenario: When two open changes modify the same Requirement heading of a capability,...

WHEN `plan-time-collision-detection` is implemented
THEN When two open changes modify the same Requirement heading of a capability, the second /plan-feature run reports the collision, the other change, and its owner before tasks are generated.

### Requirement: The scanner produces results with only a git remote available and no coordinator

The system SHALL ensure that the scanner produces results with only a git remote available and no coordinator.

#### Scenario: The scanner produces results with only a git remote available and no coordinator

WHEN `plan-time-collision-detection` is implemented
THEN The scanner produces results with only a git remote available and no coordinator.

### Requirement: Each reported collision is classified as intent, requirement, contract, or...

The system SHALL ensure that each reported collision is classified as intent, requirement, contract, or file level.

#### Scenario: Each reported collision is classified as intent, requirement, contract, or...

WHEN `plan-time-collision-detection` is implemented
THEN Each reported collision is classified as intent, requirement, contract, or file level.

### Requirement: An unavailable or failing scanner emits a warning and never blocks planning

The system SHALL ensure that an unavailable or failing scanner emits a warning and never blocks planning.

#### Scenario: An unavailable or failing scanner emits a warning and never blocks planning

WHEN `plan-time-collision-detection` is implemented
THEN An unavailable or failing scanner emits a warning and never blocks planning.

### Requirement: The simulation harness's same-requirement scenario flips from not-detected...

The system SHALL ensure that the simulation harness's same-requirement scenario flips from not-detected to detected.

#### Scenario: The simulation harness's same-requirement scenario flips from not-detected...

WHEN `plan-time-collision-detection` is implemented
THEN The simulation harness's same-requirement scenario flips from not-detected to detected.
